Recall the following special limit: 

$$
e={lim}_{n\to \infty }{(1+\frac{1}{n})}^{n}
$$

Now, we rewrite the given limit using the algebra of limits, as follows:

$$
\begin{aligned}{lim}_{n\to \infty }{(1+\frac{1}{n})}^{-9n} & ={lim}_{n\to \infty }{[{(1+\frac{1}{n})}^{n}]}^{-9} \\  & ={[{lim}_{n\to \infty }{(1+\frac{1}{n})}^{n}]}^{-9} \\  & ={e}^{-9} \\  & =\frac{1}{{e}^{9}}\end{aligned}
$$
